text: dsh-sidebar-shelf（DSH 插件，Web/桌面端）：把左侧栏中注册的面板入口收进一个面板架，让侧栏为工作区留出空间。它在原生面板列表注册自己的入口，折叠其他面板行；打开后以两列展示面板，并在面板较多时提供搜索。选择面板会调用 DSH 的面板选择接口；遵循约定的外部侧栏入口也可加入面板架。适合希望整理侧栏、快速查找并打开面板的 DSH 用户。无需 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-sidebar-shelf (DSH Web/desktop) gathers sidebar panels into one shelf, freeing workspace space. Open its native row to browse panels; search appears above seven entries. Choose a panel to open it. No API key or external service is required.
想把 DSH 侧栏里一长串面板入口收起来，给工作区多留点位置。
面板太多不好找，有没有能在侧栏里搜索并打开面板的方式？
I want one compact sidebar entry that lets me find and open my DSH panels.
dsh-sidebar-shelf 的功能「面板收纳与搜索」：点击侧栏原生的 Panels 入口展开面板架，以两列列出已注册面板；面板数量超过七个时显示搜索框，可筛选后选择面板打开。
dsh-sidebar-shelf 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 8 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · dsh-sidebar-shelf：**Give the DSH sidebar back its space.** Every left-sidebar panel entry folds into one quiet shelf that sits exactly where the panels used to be — above the workspace. Open a panel only when you need it.

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[](LICENSE)

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Why：The DSH Web/desktop sidebar stacks its brand row, **New Session**, **every global panel entry**, the workspace list, and Settings. Each plugin that adds a panel adds a row to that column — plugin manager, plugin market, schedules, MCP studio, context, skills, system monitor. Ten rows is roughly 400px, and the workspace area is squeezed to a couple of conversations.
dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Why：`dsh-sidebar-shelf` folds **all panel entries** into a single row in that same column, right above the workspace, and brings any panel back on demand.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Why：- **One row where the panel list was.** Same place, same width, same spacing as a native panel row — the workspace moves straight up under it.
- **Adopts injected entries.** Plugins that bypass the slot and inject a row straight into the sidebar (the `data-dsh-*-entry` convention used by `dsh-webchat`, taskboard and ssh) are hidden in place and listed in the same shelf with their own icon, label and active state; choosing one clicks their own button, so their toggle keeps working.
- **A native row, not a fake one.** The shell's own button, hover state, 36px rail form and tooltip are reused; only the sibling rows are hidden.
- **A 2-column shelf** with each panel's own registered icon.
- **Search** appears once there are more than seven panels.
- **Keyboard first**: `↑`/`↓` to move, `Enter` to open, `Esc` to close, and plain typing filters.
- **Rail aware**: in the 56px sidebar rail the row is still the shell's 36px icon and the shelf opens beside the rail, not on top of it.
- **Theme aware**: only `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-radius-*` / `--dsw-shadow-*` tokens; follows light and dark themes.

```sh
dsh-sidebar-shelf README · straight from GitHub (no build step, no allowBuilds approval)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wumouren114/dsh-sidebar-shelf

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · or from a local clone：git clone https://github.com/wumouren114/dsh-sidebar-shelf.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-sidebar-shelf
```

`desktop` is the profile name in this repository's examples; substitute `web`, `tui`, or whatever profile you run. After installing, enable the plugin in **Settings → Plugins** (it is added to `dsh.profile.bundles`) and reload the page.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · or from a local clone：**Verify:** the whole panel column becomes one **Panels** row between **New Session** and **工作区 / Workspace**. Click it — every registered panel is there, including "Plugins". Picking one opens it and closes the shelf.

> This package ships a hand-written `lib/client.js`: there is no `prepare`/`postinstall` script, so a GitHub install never stops at pnpm's `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` or `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`.
dsh-sidebar-shelf README · or from a local clone：Requirements: DSH 0.2.x client, Node.js ≥ 20 for the CLI that installs it.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · How it works：DSH's left sidebar is owned by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`. Third-party plugins cannot re-declare that list, but the shell publishes a small, stable contract:

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · How it works：| Contract | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist` slot (root scope, list) | Every panel registers an icon component with `id` / `order` / `label`. The shelf registers one entry of its own here (`order: -1000`) and reads the rest of the registry as its data source. |
| The registered row's DOM | The shell wraps our icon in its own `<button class="panelRow">`. From the glyph we find that button, mark it `data-dsh-shelf-row` and intercept its click in the capture phase. |
| `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)` | The official way to open a panel; the shelf never fakes a click on another row. |
| `ctx.layout.panelInfo` | The selected-panel source, used for the active marker inside the shelf. |

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · How it works：Nothing else is touched: no workspace rows, no brand row, no Settings, no host-side behavior, no DSH files. Unmounting the plugin removes the marker, the handler and the stylesheet, and the native rows come back.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Verified：- DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, Windows, Chromium 1440×900 — 23/23 end-to-end checks: placement above the workspace, sibling-only hiding, search, keyboard, panel switching, active marker, Escape, adoption of a DOM-injected `data-dsh-*-entry` row (hidden in place, listed first, own click handler runs, active state reflected), 56px rail, dark theme, no page errors.
- `node test/smoke.mjs` — 10 manifest/bundle/wiring checks, no dependencies.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Verified：The screenshots above were produced by `test/e2e.cjs` against a throwaway profile; the panels in them come from a test-only fixture (`test/demo-panels`), not from shipped code.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Known limitations：- **Every other panel row is hidden**, including the shell's own "More" menu (`Browse other plugins` / `Create your plugin`). The Plugins panel is still one click away in the shelf.
- **Injected rows are adopted only when they follow the `data-dsh-*-entry` convention** (as `dsh-webchat`, taskboard and ssh do). A plugin that injects a row without that marker stays in the sidebar.
- One plugin, one job: there is no per-panel pin/hide policy yet. If you need "keep these three in the sidebar", say so in an issue — it is the natural next step.
- Do not pair it with another plugin that hides the same list (e.g. `dsh-toomuch-plugins`, `dsh-sidebar-organizer`); pick one.
- The DOM contract is the shell's panel-row button inside the list. If a future DSH release changes that structure, the worst case is an un-hidden list, never a broken sidebar.

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · Development：```sh
node test/smoke.mjs                  # static + wiring checks, no browser
node test/e2e.cjs <dsh-web-url>     # real UI checks + screenshots (needs puppeteer-core)
```

`test/e2e.cjs` expects `NODE_PATH` to point at a `node_modules` that contains `puppeteer-core`, and a Chromium/Edge binary (override with `DSH_SHOT_BROWSER`). The repo has no build step: `lib/client.js` is the shipped bundle.

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 为什么：DSH Web / 桌面端的左侧栏从上到下是：品牌行 → **新会话** → **每个全局面板入口** → 工作区 → 设置。每装一个带面板的插件，这一列就多一行：插件、插件市场、定时任务、MCP Studio、上下文、技能管理、系统监控…… 十行大约 400px，工作区被挤得只剩两三个会话。

`dsh-sidebar-shelf` 把**所有面板入口**收成同一列里的一行——就在工作区正上方，想用哪个再展开。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 为什么：- **一行就在原面板列表的位置**：宽度、间距、悬浮态都和原生面板行一致，工作区直接上移。
- **收养外部入口**：绕过槽位、直接往侧栏根节点插行的插件（`dsh-webchat`、taskboard、ssh 使用的 `data-dsh-*-entry` 约定）也会被隐藏并放进同一个收纳架，图标、名字、激活态都跟随原入口；点它时触发原按钮自己的点击，开关逻辑照旧。
- **用的是原生行**，不是自绘按钮：外壳自己的按钮、56px 轨道形态、Tooltip 都沿用，只隐藏它的兄弟行。
- **两列面板架**，每个面板用它自己注册的图标。
- **面板超过 7 个自动出现搜索框**。
- **键盘优先**：`↑`/`↓` 移动、`Enter` 打开、`Esc` 关闭，直接打字就是过滤。
- **窄栏适配**：侧栏收成 56px 轨道时，这一行仍是外壳的 36px 图标，收纳架在轨道右侧展开，不盖住轨道。
- **跟随主题**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsw-radius-*` / `--dsw-shadow-*` 主题变量，明暗主题都一致。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 为什么：| 打开面板后 | 56px 轨道 | 暗色主题 |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |

**验证方式：** 整列面板入口变成 **新会话** 与 **工作区** 之间的一行 **面板**。点它——所有已注册面板都在里面（包括「插件」）。选一个即打开，收纳架自动关闭。

> 本包直接提交手写的 `lib/client.js`，**没有 `prepare` / `postinstall` 脚本**，所以从 GitHub 安装不会卡在 pnpm 的 `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` 或 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`。
dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 或者从本地 clone：环境要求：DSH 0.2.x 客户端；安装它的命令行需要 Node.js ≥ 20。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 实现原理：DSH 的左侧栏由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` 拥有。第三方插件不能重新声明这个列表，但外壳公开了一组稳定契约：

| 契约 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist` 槽（root 作用域，list） | 每个面板在这里注册 `id` / `order` / `label` 和图标组件。收纳架自己也在这里注册一行（`order: -1000`），其余注册项就是它的数据源。 |
| 注册行所在的 DOM | 外壳把我们的图标包进它自己的 `<button class="panelRow">`。我们从图标向上找到这个按钮，标记 `data-dsh-shelf-row`，并在捕获阶段拦截它的点击。 |
| `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)` | 官方选中面板的方式；收纳架从不伪造点击别的行。 |
| `ctx.layout.panelInfo` | 当前选中面板，用于收纳架里的「当前」标记。 |

具体到 `lib/client.js`：

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 实现原理：1. 在 `sidebar.panellist` 注册自己的一行（`id: dsh-sidebar-shelf-entry`、`order: -1000`、label `面板` / `Panels`）；
2. 从图标向上找到外壳的面板行按钮，打标记，并挂捕获阶段的 click 处理器——既打开收纳架，也阻止外壳对一个没有主面板的 id 调用 `selectPanel`；
3. 用一条作用域受限的规则隐藏兄弟行：`[data-dsh-shelf="on"] > nav > *:not([data-dsh-shelf-row]) { display: none !important }`——列表元素本身保持挂载，所以这一行保留外壳原生的位置、间距和轨道几何；
4. 同时观察侧栏根节点里由其它插件注入的行（`data-dsh-*-entry`），原地隐藏并放到收纳架最前面，图标、标签、`data-active` 激活态都跟随原行；点它时触发原行自己的 `click()`；
5. 读 `ctx.slots.entriesOfSlot("sidebar.panellist")` 作为收纳架其余内容，复刻侧栏自己的排序（`order`，再按注册顺序），每格直接用面板**自己注册的图标组件**（外层错误边界，失败时退回首字母）；
6. 选中已注册面板时调用 `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)`。
dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 实现原理：其它什么都不碰：不动工作区、品牌行、设置，不加宿主行为，也不改 DSH 的任何文件。插件卸载时标记、监听与样式一并移除，原生面板列自动回来。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 已验证：- DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` / Windows / Chromium 1440×900 —— 23/23 端到端检查：入口位于工作区上方、只隐藏兄弟行、搜索、键盘、切换面板、当前标记、Esc、收养 DOM 注入的 `data-dsh-*-entry` 行（原地隐藏、排在最前、原点击处理器仍执行、激活态同步）、56px 轨道、暗色主题、无页面报错。
- `node test/smoke.mjs` —— 10 项清单 / bundle / 接线检查，零依赖。

上面的截图由 `test/e2e.cjs` 在一次性测试 profile 里产生；截图里的面板来自仅用于测试的 fixture（`test/demo-panels`），不随包发布。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 已知限制：- **其它面板行全部隐藏**，包括外壳自带的「更多」菜单（浏览更多插件 / 创建你的插件）。「插件」面板仍在收纳架里一步可达。
- **只有遵循 `data-dsh-*-entry` 约定的注入行会被收养**（`dsh-webchat`、taskboard、ssh 都是）。不按这个约定插行的插件仍会留在侧栏里。
- 一个插件只做一件事：暂时没有「固定某几个面板留在侧栏」的策略。需要的话请开 issue，这是下一步最自然的方向。
- 不要和另一个同样隐藏该列表的插件（如 `dsh-toomuch-plugins`、`dsh-sidebar-organizer`）同时使用，二选一。
- DOM 契约是列表里那枚外壳面板行按钮。如果未来 DSH 改了结构，最坏情况是列表没被隐藏，而不会把侧栏弄坏。

dsh-sidebar-shelf README · 开发：```sh
node test/smoke.mjs                  # 静态 + 接线检查，不需要浏览器
node test/e2e.cjs <dsh-web-url>     # 真实 UI 检查 + 截图（需要 puppeteer-core）
```

`test/e2e.cjs` 要求 `NODE_PATH` 指向含 `puppeteer-core` 的 `node_modules`，并准备 Chromium / Edge（可用 `DSH_SHOT_BROWSER` 覆盖）。仓库没有构建步骤：`lib/client.js` 就是发布产物。
